bio: This grand dining room in the Britannia hotel comes complete with mirrors, sparkling chandeliers and even a Caviar Bar. Choose one of the large tables or, if you want to interact with the chefs, opt to sit at the counter, where you’re served at the same time as your fellow guests. The intricate and technically accomplished dishes have a classical base and make great use of the best Norwegian ingredients, with the exceptional snacks a brilliant way to kick things off....
